high_level_description: This image is a celebratory graphic for Indian Navy Day, featuring the theme "SAM NO VARUNAH," which translates to "We Are the Guardians" in English. The design is dominated by a black background with bold, colorful text and images that highlight various aspects of the Indian Navy. The word "INDIAN" is written in large, block letters, with "IN" in orange and "DIAN" in green. The word "NAVY" is prominently displayed in the center, with each letter cut out to reveal different images behind it. The letters are black with white outlines, creating a striking contrast
